zh.title: Router 为什么没有被消息淹没？
zh.lead: 调节事件到达量与合批上限，观察队列；再对照原文的真实测量端点。
zh.diagramLabel: 可调节合批与分片的离散队列模型
zh.modelHint: 固定教学假设：每批占用 2 轮；本页共回放 6 轮，每轮先结算、再到达、再派发。不对应真实秒数或吞吐预测。
zh.shardHint: 两个分片维护各自上下文；跨片任务关联需要额外协调。原型并未提供这里的分片实现。
zh.sharedHint: 一个 Router 维护统一协调上下文；合批减少逐事件请求，但仍受上下文与判断准确率约束。
zh.caption: 合批改变每次调用携带的事件数；分片改变协调上下文的边界。
zh.measureTitle: 原文测量：负载升高，请求时间与决策时间不同向变化
zh.low: 约 1 个待决策 Trigger / 分钟
zh.high: 约 40 个待决策 Trigger / 分钟
zh.measureCaption: 只展示 §7.2 报告的两个近似端点，不插值。一次决策可能调用模型多次，不能用请求时间直接除以批大小替代。
zh.limit0: 代码节选展示每 Thread 的 Eval 合批；文章还讨论 Router 下一次推理收取积累输入，二者粒度不同。
zh.limit1: 原文实测 Router 使用真实模型，Workers 使用 mock；不能据此保证任意真实工作负载的吞吐。
zh.limit2: 分片和 Router 专门训练在文章中仍属扩展方向；长时间运行的长期记忆问题也未解决。
zh.question: 合批上限变大，吞吐就一定无限增长吗？
zh.answer: 不会。这个固定耗时模型只展示排队机制；真实 Prefill 成本、上下文上限和批内判断质量都会限制收益。

en.simulation: Teaching model · No real agents or external commands
en.codeNote: Below: source excerpts or explicitly labeled design summaries. Interactive scenarios are illustrative.
en.fallback: Enable JavaScript to operate the figure. The static diagram, conclusion, and sources work without it.
en.title: Why is the Router not overwhelmed?
en.lead: Adjust arrivals and batch capacity, inspect the queue, then compare the article’s measured endpoints.
en.diagramLabel: A discrete queue model with batching and sharding controls
en.modelHint: Fixed teaching assumptions: each batch occupies 2 rounds. Replay 6 rounds: settle, receive, then dispatch. These are not real seconds or throughput predictions.
en.shardHint: Two shards hold separate contexts; cross-shard task relations need extra coordination. This sharding model is not a prototype feature.
en.sharedHint: One Router keeps coordination context together. Batching reduces per-event requests, within context and decision-quality limits.
en.caption: Batching changes events per call. Sharding changes the boundaries of coordination context.
en.measureTitle: Reported measurements: request time and decision time move differently
en.measureCaption: Only two approximate endpoints from §7.2 are shown, without interpolation. A decision may require several model requests; request time divided by batch size is not the decision metric.
en.limit0: The excerpt batches an Eval per Thread. Router inference can also collect accumulated inputs; these are different granularities.
en.limit1: The Router benchmark uses a real Router model and mock Workers. It does not guarantee throughput for arbitrary workloads.
en.limit2: Sharding and Router-specific training remain scaling directions. Long-term memory over months is also unresolved.
en.question: Does a larger batch imply unlimited throughput?
en.answer: No. This fixed-duration model shows queue mechanics. Real prefill cost, context capacity, and decision quality limit the benefit.
